SEASONS
Seasons declared, then honoured.

Rather than fiddle with single nights, define four broad seasons and let them carry the pricing forward. Override only where the calendar — or an exhibition opening, a regional festival, the long sigh of February — calls for it.

SEASONS, AT A GLANCE
Four moods, plotted across the year.
SEASON	WINDOW	MOOD	MIN. STAY	NIGHTLY RATE	WEEKEND LIFT
High	15 Jun — 31 Aug	Bright, full, plotted in advance.	3 nights	€485	+15%
Shoulder — Spring	15 Mar — 14 Jun	Open, gentle, with longer light.	2 nights	€365	+10%
Shoulder — Autumn	1 Sep — 14 Nov	Quiet, leaves down, fireside.	2 nights	€340	+8%
Low — Deep Winter	15 Nov — 14 Mar	Hushed, for those who read.	2 nights	€295	+5%

SYNDICATION
Distributed, but never duplicated.

When you publish, the calendar pushes outward to those minutes — to the direct booking engine, to Airbnb, to the partner channels you've grown to trust over the years. Most travel-policy changes pull back inside fifteen minutes. We remain a small, considered list.
